decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's line extends the firm's established natural cosmetics range into a niche segment, but it is a multi-item series outside the core female and sensitive-skin focus, so it carries moderate risk of being pruned if sales were weak.
The cleansing foam is a low-cost addition to the existing Sandorini series that complements a core line, so small natural cosmetics makers typically keep such items for years.
